summary_text: Q1 2026 (reported May 6): revenue $1.597B (+26% YoY), adjusted EBITDA $550M (+32%). New 7-year, $7.7B Paramount UFC media rights deal drove +$51.2M UFC increase in Q1. Full-year 2026 guidance: revenue $5.675B-$5.775B, adjusted EBITDA $2.240B-$2.290B. Catalysts: media rights deals + high-profile live events (UFC Freedom 250 at White House, FIFA World Cup On Location partnership). Next earnings ~early Aug 2026 (Q2).
